column2: #287 initial independent dual-axis review (Standards + Spec; fixed point f2d6ed5, reviewed commits b1a5381 and 2dad6ab): 2 confirmed P2 findings, one per axis. Spec: after an interrupted root resumes with a higher configured max_depth, the fresh root scope could exceed the durable delegation tree's persisted depth ceiling. Standards: separately cloned runtime providers created independent active-child semaphores, violating the process-wide max_active_children bound. Both findings were corrected and independently re-reviewed in fcb15c2; no findings remain. Focused verification on the correction: 120 passed, 3 Docker-dependent skipped; Ruff and diff-check passed.
